verdict.rationale: The docs describe a prepaid-credit model: users top up via Billing → Add Credit. The billing docs note that keeping a positive balance protects instances from interruption or deletion, which implies a running instance stops consuming money once credit runs out. Autobilling can be left off, so the loaded balance acts as an implicit spending ceiling, but this is a crude backstop that risks losing the instance rather than a deliberate guardrail. Missing for 10: configurable auto-shutdown or idle timers, explicit per-instance or account spend limits, budget alerts, and any hands-on confirmation of how instances behave when credit is exhausted.
